task: Allow Istio ambient kubelet probe SNAT and HBONE traffic while preserving workload source restrictions

events.summary: Scope covers the probe SNAT exception, ambient namespace HBONE ingress, bootstrap ordering, static regression coverage, and a live verifier for Narwhal#235

Issue #235 live cilium-dbg monitor drop evidence showed world->1397 169.254.7.127:51468 -> 10.0.3.168:8000 and identity 6832->1397 10.0.2.129:39770 -> 10.0.3.168:15008 denied after GitOps bootstrap; CNPG probes restarted and Keycloak lost its database connection

Kept the allow-only probe CCNP and early bootstrap apply; added TCP/15008 to every existing port-limited rule in repo-owned policies and upstream ArgoCD policies so each rule retains its from peers; left the tuning Job ingress empty
Round 2 verification requires per-rule HBONE, rejects a peer-less HBONE-only rule beside peer-restricted rules, accepts ingress: [] and all-ports rules, and rejects a port-limited rule missing 15008

Round 2 static suite passed 225 checks with 0 failures and 4 existing warnings; make validate, ShellCheck, repo policy checks, and static ambient mutation gate passed. Live ambient verifier could not reach the configured Kubernetes API at 192.168.77.10:6443 and was interrupted after repeated i/o timeouts; live cluster confirmation remains pending
